# 表单填写测试 目标：测试 App 中表单页面的输入、选择、提交和结果验证流程: # Form filling test Goal: Test the input, selection, submission and result verification process of the form page in the App. Please follow the instructions when generating scripts: 1. First enter the target App and target form page, and wait for the page to stably display fields, titles or submit buttons. 2. Input, selection, check, upload, and submission must be separated into independent steps. Do not use one aiAct to fill in all fields and submit at the same time. 3. The value of aiInput must come entirely from the user’s original needs; do not rewrite, desensitize, complete or make up sample values. 4. The page, field name, nearby text or business meaning of each input box must be clearly stated, such as "Contact name input box on the shipping address page". 5. Use aiTap first for stable visible controls such as drop-down selection, date selection, radio selection, multi-selection, and switches; if you need to "check only if it is not checked" or "keep the default value if there is one", use a single aiAct. 6. Wait for clear results after submission: success prompts, details pages, new items in the list, status changes, or error prompts; don’t just judge that the button is clicked. 7. If the test verification of this use case fails, keep the error status and read or wait for the error prompt. Do not automatically correct the input and continue to submit.

# 聊天对话测试 目标：测试 App 的聊天、客服或消息会话流程。 生成脚本时请: #Chat conversation test Goal: Test the chat, customer service or messaging conversation flow of the App. Please follow the instructions when generating scripts: 1. First enter the target conversation page and wait for the conversation title, message list, input box or send button to be displayed stably. 2. When sending text, use independent aiInput to locate the message input box, and then use aiTap to click the send button; do not combine input and sending into a generalized aiAct. 3. When sending pictures, expressions, voices, files and other content, first open the corresponding portal, then select the material or perform recording, and finally wait for the message bubble to appear. 4. The emoticon panel, more panel, voice recording overlay, picture preview, and customer service welcome message on the chat page may be targets for testing. Do not close them as interfering pop-up windows. 5. If you need to verify the reply, use aiWaitFor to wait for the other party's message, customer service reply, sent success status or read status; use aiQuery or aiString when you need to extract the reply content. 6. Keep failure prompts for failure scenarios, such as sending failure, network exception, and withdrawal prompts. Do not automatically retry until success unless the original requirement explicitly requires retry. 7. The final success determination must fall on visible messages, status tags, conversation list updates, or unread changes.

# 播放器相关测试 目标：测试 App 中视频、音频或直播播放器的播放控制和状态: # Player related tests Goal: Test the playback control and status verification of video, audio or live broadcast players in the App. When generating scripts, please follow: 1. Player controls, play/pause buttons, progress bars, full-screen buttons, clarity menus, double-speed menus, barrage switches, preview prompts, and advertising patches may be targets to be tested and should not be turned off by default. 2. After entering the play page, wait for the player area, title or first frame to be displayed stably, and then perform actions such as play, pause, drag progress, switch resolution or full screen. 3. Use aiTap when clicking a clear button; use aiWaitFor when you need to wait for buffering to complete, playback to start, pause state, horizontal screen to complete, or progress to change. 4. If testing pre-roll ads or membership preview prompts, keep the ads or prompts and verify the display, countdown, skip or purchase entry; do not automatically skip. 5. If testing a normal playback link, only permissions, upgrades, and activity pop-ups that are unrelated to the playback target and block operations can be processed separately. 6. Use aiQuery, aiString or aiNumber when reading playback duration, current progress, definition, multiple speed, title or live broadcast status, and describe their positions in the player. 7. The final success determination should be an observable state, such as the video is playing, the button changes to pause, the progress has changed, it has entered full screen, the resolution has been switched, or a playback completion prompt appears.

# 搜索和列表测试 目标：测试 App 中搜索、筛选、排序、列表加载和详情页进入: # Search and list testing Goal: Test the search, filtering, sorting, list loading and details page entry process in the App. Please follow the instructions when generating scripts: 1. First enter the search page or list page, and wait for the search box, filter entry, list area or empty state to be displayed stably. 2. Use aiInput to enter search terms, and confirm using aiTap or the keyboard to submit a search; separate steps are used for filtering, sorting, and category switching. 3. Search terms, filter conditions, and sorting methods must come from the original requirements and do not replace them with sample values. 4. List results need to wait for clear visible signals, such as result cards, titles, prices, status, empty result copy, or loading completion prompts. 5. Use aiQuery when you need to read multiple results, and specify the return field; when you need to click on a result, clarify the target of "the first one/contains a certain text/a certain status". 6. Scroll loading is only generated when the demand clearly requires more results, and waits for new content to appear after each scroll. 7. The final success determination should be that the result exists, the empty status is correct, the filtered result meets the conditions, the sorting takes effect, or the core information of the details page is visible.

# 订单和支付测试 目标：测试商品/服务选择、提交订单、支付方式选择和订单结果验: # Order and payment testing Goal: Test product/service selection, order submission, payment method selection and order result verification. Please follow the instructions when generating scripts: 1. After entering the product, shopping cart, service page or order page, wait for the core information to be displayed stably. 2. Select specifications, quantity, address, coupons, payment method, submit order, and confirm payment into independent steps. 3. For high-risk actions such as real payment, deduction, transfer, cash withdrawal, and purchase, click confirmation payment will be generated only when the original demand clearly requires execution; otherwise, stop at the payment confirmation page and verify the page status. 4. Key data such as amount, product name, address, discount information, payment method, etc. are first read using aiQuery or aiString and then verified with visible results. 5. Sensitive inputs such as payment passwords, verification codes, and SMS codes must come entirely from the original requirements and cannot be fabricated. 6. If the test fails, wait for and read the failure prompt, insufficient inventory, insufficient balance, risk control prompt or payment cancellation status, and do not automatically change the payment method to continue. 7. The final success determination shall be successful order submission, successful payment, change in order status, appearance of the order number or correct information on the payment confirmation page.

# 权限和弹窗测试 目标：测试 App 中权限申请、协议确认、升级提示、活动弹窗: # Permission and pop-up window testing Goal: Test the display and processing of permission application, agreement confirmation, upgrade prompt, activity pop-up window, guide page or business pop-up window in the App. When generating the script, please follow the following: 1. First determine whether the pop-up window is the target to be tested or an interference blocker: if the requirement is to test the pop-up window, do not close it; if the pop-up window only blocks subsequent operations, generate processing steps. 2. The button positioning of pop-up windows such as permissions, agreements, upgrades, activities, ratings, notification guidance, etc. should be clearly stated, such as "Allow button in the permission pop-up window" and "Tell me later button in the upgrade pop-up window." 3. If the link is allowed by the test authority, click Allow and wait for the business page to continue loading; if the link is denied by the test, click Deny and wait for the error prompt, downgrade entry or permission guidance page. 4. If you test a forced upgrade, you cannot click Update Download Now; wait and assert the forced upgrade pop-up window content and button status. 5. If testing an activity or marketing pop-up window, keep the pop-up window and read the title, activity copy, button or close the entrance; do not close it as an advertisement by default. 6. Use a single aiAct for conditional processing, such as "If an irrelevant pop-up window appears, close it, otherwise keep the current state"; do not use boolean to only judge and not operate. 7. The final success determination should be that the content of the pop-up window is correct, the pop-up window is closed correctly, the permission result takes effect, or the subsequent pages are unobstructed.

# 个人资料和设置测试 目标：测试 App 的个人中心、资料编辑、设置项、账号安: # Personal data and settings testing Goal: Test the App’s personal center, data editing, setting items, account security or logout process. If a switch control requires "open/close to a certain state", use conditional aiAct to avoid reverse switching; if you just click a clear switch, use aiTap. 5. High-risk actions such as logging out, canceling accounts, and clearing data should only be performed when clearly required by the original requirements; otherwise, stop at the confirmation pop-up window and verify. 6. After saving, wait for positive results, such as a successful save prompt, new values displayed on the data page, setting status changes, or returning to the login page. 7. Use aiQuery, aiString or aiBoolean when you need to read the current data or set the status, and require visible text to be returned or true or false to be clear.

If you need to read web page content, order number, agreement text, activity rules or button status, use aiQuery, aiString or aiBoolean and describe the visible position on the screen. 6. If testing an external link jump, wait for the target page title, domain name prompt, browser selection page or return entry; do not misjudge the page after the jump as a failure. 7. The final success condition should be that the H5 content is correct, the interaction result is correct, the jump is successful, or the return to the original App page is successful.
